claim_summaries.summary: For a steady divergence-free strain-viscous flow with active support fraction beta and invariant positive-volume subsystem fraction alpha carrying an iid q-ary symbol factor at sampling interval tau, average decoded symbol error epsilon implies W >= 4 nu V alpha^2 r_epsilon^2/(beta tau^2), where r_epsilon=max(0, ln(q)-h2(epsilon)-epsilon ln(q-1)); if the code subsystem is the whole nonzero support, W >= 4 nu V alpha (r_epsilon/tau)^2.
claim_summaries.scope: Autonomous invariant positive-volume information throughput; does not cover point-to-set reachability or ordinary finite computation.

claim_summaries.scope: One published construction with external strain-viscous forcing; not a universal lower bound or cost per computation step.
